question: Quest 1's real dock fight in the D5 print, armored contractors (2.5 pistol rounds), Rivet with the table pistol and the shared hit feel. Every contractor burst is now told: he stops, a dashed vermilion aim line tracks Rivet for 0.18 s, then goes solid with a cream glint on the muzzle for 0.17 s (the lock: the aim no longer moves), then 4 slowed rounds (13.5 m/s) go down the locked line. Should the locked burst stay on the drawn line (tight) or spray the rifle's full 8-degree cone? In the dodge clips a scripted player strafes across the line on each lock.

options.label: Tight: the burst keeps 0.3 of the cone, so the told line is the danger zone
options.tradeoff: honest tell: standing still eats 60/60 rounds, strafing on the lock 17/48 (the rest is crossfire from a 2nd gunner); the read decides

options.label: Full cone: the rifle's 8-degree spray down the locked line (quest 1's own spread)
options.tradeoff: softer: standing still eats 25/60, strafing 9/48; luck matters more than the read and the line under-draws the danger
